mapper.sql: V.IRVRSN_NO, V.IPROM_NO, V.ICTNS_ID, V.SVRSN_YN, V.STABLE, V.SFLAG, V.SFULL_ITEM, V.STITLE, V.ISEQ, V.SURL, V.IRVCATE_NO, V.IRVCATE_NM, V.IRVCATE_ODR, V.SINS_DT, V.SSYS_ID, C.STITLE AS CATE_TITLE, C.ISEQ AS CATE_SEQ, C.SORGNDOWN_YN AS ORGN_DOWN_YN
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_REL_VRSN V LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_REL_VRSN_CATE C ON V.IRVCATE_NO = C.IRVCATE_NO WHERE V.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND ( V.SFLAG IS NULL OR V.SFLAG = 'PROMULGATION' ) ORDER BY NVL(C.ISEQ, 9999), C.STITLE, NVL(V.ISEQ, 9999), V.IRVRSN_NO

SELECT FROM TB_REL_VRSN V LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_REL_VRSN_CATE C ON V.IRVCATE_NO = C.IRVCATE_NO WHERE V.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND V.SFLAG = #{flag}'PROVISION' AND V.SFULL_ITEM = #{fullItem} ORDER BY NVL(C.ISEQ, 9999), C.STITLE, NVL(V.ISEQ, 9999), V.IRVRSN_NO

SELECT D.IDOCU_NO AS "docuNo", A.IATT_NO AS "attNo", NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(F.STITLE), ''), A.SNAME) AS "title", A.SEXT AS "ext", A.ISIZE AS "fileSize", NVL(A.IDOWN_CNT, 0) AS "downCnt" FROM TB_DOCU D JOIN TB_REL_VRSN V ON V.IPROM_NO = D.IPROM_NO AND V.SFLAG = 'DOCUMENT' AND V.SFULL_ITEM = D.SITEM JOIN TB_REL_FILE F ON F.IRVRSN_NO = V.IRVRSN_NO AND NVL(F.SDEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' JOIN TB_ATTACH A ON A.IATT_NO = F.IATT_NO WHERE D.IDOCU_NO IN #{no} ORDER BY D.IDOCU_NO, NVL(V.ISEQ, 9999), A.IATT_NO
SELECT FROM TB_REL_VRSN V LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_REL_VRSN_CATE C ON V.IRVCATE_NO = C.IRVCATE_NO WHERE V.IRVRSN_NO = #{relVrsnNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REL_VRSN ( IRVRSN_NO, IPROM_NO, ICTNS_ID, SVRSN_YN, STABLE, SFLAG, SFULL_ITEM, STITLE, ISEQ, SURL, IRVCATE_NO, IRVCATE_NM, IRVCATE_ODR, SINS_DT ) VALUES ( #{relVrsnNo}, #{promNo}, #{ctnsId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vrsnYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stable}, #{flag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fullItem,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{url,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cateNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cateName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cateOrder,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{insDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REL_VRSN SET STITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ISEQ = #{seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SURL = #{url,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IRVCATE_NO = #{cateNo,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, IRVCATE_NM = #{cateName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IRVCATE_ODR = #{cateOrder,jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE IRVRSN_NO = #{relVrsnNo}
